items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: Hitler proved that when he had this march you know.

ctx.x: No. I wouldn’t want to think about that.

So see what I mean? And my instrument has been more devastating than bombs. You know to strike the fear into a human being. Hitler proved that when he had this march you know. In the early years of Africa the drums — hey you heard them, boom, boom, right? And the Indians — boom, boom, boom, boom you know? Hey man. As a matter of fact you could take, right here in New York, believe me, trust me, you could take a one hundred piece orchestra, or one hundred piece marching band, and let them march down Fifth Avenue,…
It’s impossible for them to walk by it without—
